mapper.sql: select q.question_id, q.category, q.qtype, q.level, q.title, q.score, q.status, q.use_count, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.remark from jc_edu_question q
mapper.select: select q.question_id, q.category, q.qtype, q.level, q.title, q.options, q.answer, q.analysis, q.score, q.status, q.use_count, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark from jc_edu_question q where q.question_id = #{questionId} and q.del_flag = '0'
select q.question_id, q.category, q.qtype, q.title, q.options, q.answer, q.analysis, q.score, q.use_count from jc_edu_question q where q.question_id in #{id} and q.del_flag = '0'

select q.question_id, q.category, q.qtype, q.title, q.options, q.answer, q.analysis, q.score from jc_edu_question q where q.category = #{category} and q.qtype = #{qtype} and q.status = '0' and q.del_flag = '0' order by rand() limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update jc_edu_question set use_count = ifnull(use_count, 0) + 1, update_by = 'system' where question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: insert into jc_edu_question ( category, qtype, level, title, options, answer, analysis, score, status, use_count, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{category}, #{qtype}, #{level}, #{title}, #{options}, #{answer}, #{analysis}, #{score}, ifnull(#{status}, '0'), ifnull(#{useCount}, 0), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.delete: update jc_edu_question set del_flag = '2' where question_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_edu_question where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from jc_edu_question where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
